text: Hello everyone, now let's begin the second period.In this period, we are going to learn reading and interaction too, the 1940s house deep reading.By the end of this period, you are expected to compare and explain the differences in life between the 1940s and the present in terms of housing, personal safety, food, daily routine and family life through deep reading.You will understand the writing purpose of the reading passage and the importance of family affection.In the previous period, we had the general idea of the story of a social experiment in which a 21st century family in London travelled in time to the 1940s.In fact, the 1940s house is a TV reality show produced in 2001.Many families volunteered to apply for this program at that time.The Heimers was one of them.Now let's watch a video clip about the 1940s house.While watching the video, please think about two questions.Why did so many families want to apply for this TV reality show?What is the writing purpose of the reading passage?One British family is volunteering to go back in time.The destination, an ordinary home during the dark days of the Second World War.This country is at war with Germany.Here they will face the hunger.These are our carrots.Sodate.The uncertainty.Oh God, we've nothing else to eat.I knew this would bloody happen.The day-to-day hardships of millions of British civilians living through the war on the home front.Is he still on the toilet?You have the children, I've got the baby.It's been magical history taught.Every day has brought more surprises.Well, can you guess the reasons why many families wanted to take part in this TV reality show?In my opinion, people in the 21st century get bored with the simple modern life without a lot of labor-challenging daily routine.They want to challenge themselves with the hardship during the wartime and experience a different life, which may provoke their reflection upon their present life or bring some change to their family life.As for the writing purpose, most readers may think the writer wants to tell us the differences in life between past and present.Do you agree?What else does the writer want to tell us?I will put the question aside right now.Let's answer it at the end of this period.In the reading passage, the writer did compare life today with life in the 1940s.Now let's go deeper into the text and explore the differences in life between past and present in terms of housing, personal safety, food, daily routine, and family life.I will give you three minutes for preparation.Please review the reading passage and write down some information on your worksheet.Thank you for watching this video.Now let's explore the differences one by one.What about the house in the 1940s?Lin lived in a three-bedroomed house in South London with her family.What can we find in this 1940s house?It was poorly equipped.There were no labor-saving devices such as central heating, but luckily there was a coal fire.You can see it from the picture.It may take a long time to warm the house.But in modern life, she lives in a modern open-plan house, which has rooms with different functions.From the picture we know, an open-plan house is large and has plenty of space to move around in.What can we find in their modern house?There may be a central heating system in the modern house and many labor-saving devices such as a washing machine and a microwave.Well, I have a question here.Do you like the coal fire or the central heating?You may think it is a silly question.No one will choose the coal fire if we have the central heating.But do you have the different thinking?Actually, the coal fire reminds me of the Christmas Eve when family members sit around it exchanging gifts in Western countries.Because the heat provided by the coal fire is far less than the central heating system,人們必須身體靠近它,以保持自己的溫暖,這增加了家庭關係。OK,接著,個人安全。在1940年代,個人安全是最重要的因為戰爭危險。人們必須身體靠近它,以保持自己的溫暖,這增加了家庭關係。你可能沒有經歷過。但從電影中,在戰爭時期,我們可以想像,人們的生活在這個小黑洞裡,特別是當人們聽到溫暖的聲音。但作為一個家庭,人們可以鼓勵和保護自己,因為他們總是想著家庭成員的安全和生活。他們唯一的希望是能夠活著,能夠保護自己的家鄉。那她的生活呢?她的生活應該很平和。從戰爭結束前一段時間,Ling不需要擔心安全。現在,我們來談談食物。1940年代,人們吃了什麼?沒有太多肉或牛奶或蛋。而且食物很麻煩,因為貨物的分量。從照片中我們可以看到,每個人都有分量書。例如,當一個人去買咖啡時,店員會把分量書寫上,以示人們的分量有足夠的分量。所以,人們經常都會餓。但是,你覺得家庭會做什麼,當人們吃了什麼?我猜,他們會有更多的家庭會議,以製造好貨物的預算。他們可能會覺得分享和提供的貴。在現代時代,孩子們會有餐飲,人們會提供很多食物。其實,我們每天都可以吃很多不同的食物,以及享受不同的餐廳,從不同的國家到不同的餐廳。就像在奧斯佛路上的美味食物。歡迎來到《日常日常》。在現代時代,很多的科技和技術的發展,很多的聰明、機械、勞動性的家庭服務都會出現。這使我們可以輕易完成家庭的工作。但是,你覺得現代女人的家庭生活是怎樣的?在1940年代,女人比現代女人更開心。現代女人的家庭生活是怎樣的?看似是,因為現代女人可以享受自己的生活,不需要擔心家庭工作。但是,在1940年代,女人可能會有自己的開心,從家庭生活中出現。家庭成員幫助分享工作,讓家庭成長得更親密。這就是為什麼Ling失去1940年代的家庭。她們花了更多的時間在一起。晚上,她們會玩球賽,跟孩子們玩,讀書,或聊天。晚上,家庭會做什麼?你能否完成這句話?你能否想像一下Ling在家裡的生活當中會如何?在現代女人生活中,家庭成員可能更加集中在自己的工作,並且更加有活力。在現代女人生活中,她們可以得到團結,還可以更加有活力。在現代女人生活中,家庭成員可能更加集中在自己的工作,還可更加有活力。cias
